items.author: Teoretik-A
items.body:
## Type
Enhancement

## Problem / Value
Some self-hosted or custom OpenAI-compatible embedding services reject large batch requests (e.g., 413/422), causing indexing to fail. Allowing a max items-per-batch setting ensures compatibility and smoother indexing.

## Context
Users integrating with custom embedding servers may have strict per-request batch limits. Today Roo batches by tokens but not by item count, which can exceed provider limits.

## Proposal
- Add a setting to cap the maximum number of items per embedding batch for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Default behavior remains unlimited
items.title: [ENHANCEMENT] Configurable max batch size for OpenAI-compatible embedding servers
